dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. How do I change my password?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. ˈhaʊ duː aɪ ˈtʃeɪndʒ maɪ ˈpæswɜːrd?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: It's easy. First, open the app. Then click here, on your name.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈiːzi. ˈfɜːrst, ˈoʊpən ði ˈæp. ˈðɛn ˈklɪk ˈhɪr, ɑːn jʊr ˈneɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. What do I do next?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈwʌt duː aɪ ˈduː ˈnɛkst?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Type your username and your old password.
dialogue.reading: ˈtaɪp jʊr ˈjuːzərneɪm ənd jʊr ˈoʊld ˈpæswɜːrd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Is my username my email address?
dialogue.reading: ɪz maɪ ˈjuːzərneɪm maɪ ˈiːmeɪl ˌædrɛs?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is. Now type your new password. Don't use your birthday!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ɪt ˈɪz. ˈnaʊ ˈtaɪp jʊr ˈnuː ˈpæswɜːrd. ˈdoʊnt ˈjuːz jʊr ˈbɜːrθdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. Now click "Save," and that's it!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈnaʊ ˈklɪk "ˈseɪv," ənd ðæts ɪt!
